caption:
A full schedule feels like proof you're winning.

It isn't. It just means the leads who got a fast callback filled your week, while the rest went quiet without you noticing.

The five-minute test: pull your last 20 leads, calls, texts, form fills. Mark each one booked or lost.

Most owners run this and find they're converting under half, even in a busy month. Being slammed and being profitable are two different numbers.

The free Lead Response Audit runs this same check on your process.
